title: Add syscall mocking smoke tests for the Linux VM runner path
rationale: This repository is Go-first and the relevant runner path lives under internal/adapters/linux rather than a Rust integration crate.
The namespace runner shells out to unshare/pkill/which, so that command-execution layer was treated as the syscall equivalent and abstracted behind an interface for mocking.
notes: Added go.uber.org/mock via a local replace to a vendored copy from the existing module cache because the sandbox has no DNS access for proxy.golang.org.
Smoke tests verify ordered LookPath -> Start -> Run behavior and propagate ENOSYS and EPERM failures through the namespace runner path.
